note: One entry per scheduled task. The page builds a View-menu tab for each. Times are IST. days: 'weekdays' = Mon-Fri (NSE holidays are skipped by the run itself), 'daily' = every day.

schedules.name: JCGG Morning Updates (Detailed)
schedules.summary: Full-depth pre-market report: global close, Asia, GIFT Nifty, commodities, VIX/INR, outlook, levels, sectors, trading ideas, corporate-action & F&O ban calendar.

schedules.name: JCGG Morning Sunrise (booklet)
schedules.summary: Morning phone booklet (English / हिन्दी / বাংলা): GIFT Nifty, global cues, levels for the day, events, mood — built by GitHub around 08:15 and posted to the Morning Sunrise page and client Telegram. Includes "Stocks in the news": company news since the last close (publishers and NSE filings), one line per stock with headline, short summary and source, ranked by expected price impact.

schedules.name: Sector Digest (booklet)

Built by GitHub from NSE's end-of-day files.
